status: HELD OUT. This set is quoted, never tuned against. Threshold sweeps read AFRVR-matcher-tune-questions.json instead. Nothing here may appear in a variant bank or an out-of-scope bank; engine/matcher_eval.mjs checks and refuses to run if it does.
authoring_note: None of these phrasings appears in any variant list in the case file. They are written in the registers section 10.6 says an author-written set tends to miss: clinical shorthand, typographical errors, compound questions and conversational openers, alongside a plain paraphrase arm for comparison. The expected topic on each row is a drafting judgement made by a language model and should be reviewed by the case author before any number from this set is quoted outside the pack.
out_of_scope_arm_note: Thirty out-of-scope questions, which is the floor section 10.6 sets and which neither earlier pack meets. They are deliberately of two kinds: questions about a real clinical topic this case does not author, which is where a matcher is most likely to answer anyway, and questions with nothing to do with medicine, which is where it should be easy. Both are counted together, which is the harder test.
compound_note: Five compound rows were recorded as __ambiguous__ when first written. They are compound rather than ambiguous: each asks two authored topics, and the shipped matcher answers both. They now carry the list of topics that must all be answered. That mapping is a drafting judgement.
